snippet.title: THE DECREE — Official Gameplay Trailer | Fulfill the Decree
snippet.description:
HUNT. CAPTURE. CHOOSE. SURVIVE.

THE DECREE

A 3-player cooperative horror game where every second counts.

The city is full of wandering souls. Track them. Capture them. Fulfill your Order before the clock runs out.

But the hunt is only part of the Decree.

Something else is waiting.

THE BUTTON.

When it appears, you'll be given a choice:

PROCEED.
STAY.

You won't know what either choice means until you make it.

Hunt souls.
Fight Soul Drainers.
Survive the clock.
Make impossible choices.
Push your run further.

The Decree can be played solo or cooperatively with up to three players.

How far can you go before the Decree breaks you?

THE DECREE
Coming to Steam.

Wishlist now:https://store.steampowered.com/app/5183380/The_Decree/
